doc: The smallest legal size, 1x1: one query at the texel center (0.5, 0.5). The jittered lump grid (60 x 60 = 3600 centers g, [x, y] in tile units, and their radii r (0.35 to 0.7 of the spacing)) is the input (plan0.g, plan0.r); freq = round(240 / 4) = 60 is read from the source (params.constants). dome = max over the 4 NEAREST lumps (by distance, periodic KD tree, not by normalized distance) of clip(1 - dist / r, 0, 1)^0.6. Measured: every random input nudged by one float64 ulp (8 trials) and numpy.fft replaced by scipy.fft: max |diff| 6e-14, because x^0.6 has an infinite slope at 0 (a distance within an ulp of r moves the value by up to (1e-16)^0.6 = 1.6e-10): 1e-9 relative, 1e-9 absolute.
